mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_cards WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND source_version_status='CURRENT' AND verified_commit IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM knowledge_cards WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND id=#{cardId}
SELECT file_path,symbol_name,start_line,end_line,content_hash FROM knowledge_code_refs WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND card_id=#{cardId} AND revision=#{revision} ORDER BY position
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_cards SET source_version_status=#{resultStatus}, verified_commit=CASE WHEN #{resultStatus}='CURRENT' THEN #{currentCommit} ELSE verified_commit END, last_verified_snapshot_id=CASE WHEN #{resultStatus}='CURRENT' THEN #{currentSnapshotId} ELSE last_verified_snapshot_id END, verification_note=#{note},source_version_checked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND id=#{cardId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT id,repo_id,card_id,card_revision,from_snapshot_id,to_snapshot_id,from_commit,to_commit, previous_status,result_status,trigger_type,reasons_payload::text AS reasons_payload, note,actor_id,created_at FROM knowledge_drift_events WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND card_id=#{cardId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
